result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and marked crosswalks, though the markings are significantly faded. A major safety concern is the tall hedge at the corner, which creates a blind spot for both drivers and pedestrians at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A tall, dense hedge at the corner blocks the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is significantly worn, reducing its visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting and Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim or remove the tall hedge near the intersection to restore clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with marked high-visibility crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While basic infrastructure like curb ramps is present, the wide intersection and parked vehicles near the crossing may limit visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection and crosswalk can block the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

result.summary: A residential street with row houses featuring a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. The wide roadway and parked vehicles near the crossing create potential visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb right up to the crosswalk limit the visibility between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, adjacent to the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, undivided roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic while crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, across the main roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the crosswalk to shorten crossing distance and improve sightlines.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The residential street features a marked but faded zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. A significant safety concern is a vehicle parked directly adjacent to the crosswalk, which severely obstructs sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Parked vehicle obstruction
hazards.description: A white car is parked immediately next to the crosswalk, blocking the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.

hazards.name: Faded markings
hazards.description: The zebra crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install ADA-compliant curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at the crossing points to ensure accessibility.
